sign: West: Madderby   North: the Rain Rift
sign_top: The rain falls here without a sound.
North: the Rain Rift. Walkers, keep to the path.
orla: Orla: The peat is grey all the way down now. It used to be the colour of strong tea.
orla_intro: Orla: A stranger on my moor? Let's see if you sink.
orla_defeat: Orla: You keep your feet. Good.
fenn: Fenn: The reeds still whisper. The people out here don't.
fenn_intro: Fenn: You talk loudly for a moor. Duel me and be quiet after.
fenn_defeat: Fenn: Fine. Talk all you like.
lusa: Lusa: Past here the rain falls upward, if you look long enough.
lusa_intro: Lusa: Before the Rift, one last test.
lusa_defeat: Lusa: Go on, then. Senna is waiting, even if she can't hear you.
